spans.s: Dukura, n. of a nāga king: Mmk 〔18.11〕.

dukūlaka (nt.?; Skt. ˚la plus -ka svārthe), a certain fine textile fabric: ˚kānāṃ tatha varakauśakānāṃ Śikṣ 〔302.6〕 (vs, may be m.c.); paṭe caiva ˚ke Mmk 〔131.21〕 (vs, may be m.c.); ˚laka-sūkṣma, subst. nt., a fine garment made of dukūla(ka): ˚maṃ vā Bhīk 〔22b.4〕 (prose), in a list of various textile fabrics. See also daukūlaka.
[? dūkūla = Skt. dukūla, a textile fabric: Śikṣ 〔208.3〕. Prob. error or misprint.]
